## motor / control / electric

**231 本**

This cluster covers the design, control, and optimization of electric motors, with emphasis on brushless DC (BLDC), induction, and stepper motor architectures. It encompasses both traditional control methods (PID, field-oriented control) and intelligent/adaptive approaches (fuzzy logic, evolutionary optimization, neural controllers).

- **Control methodologies**: PID tuning, field-oriented control (FOC), direct torque control (DTC), fuzzy logic controllers, and brain-emotional controllers for motor speed and position regulation
- **Optimization techniques**: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), genetic algorithms (GA), bacterial foraging (BF), and bat algorithm for parameter tuning of controller gains (Kp, Ki, Kd)
- **Motor architectures**: BLDC motors, induction motors, hybrid stepper motors, and permanent magnet configurations with distinct control requirements
- **Sensorless operation**: Methods to eliminate position/speed sensors while maintaining closed-loop control performance
- **Power electronics**: PWM inverter design, multilevel converters, and hardware implementation on microcontrollers (Arduino, ATmega)

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

## power / battery / gate

**292 本**

This cluster covers the intersection of power delivery, battery systems, and gate-level control in energy conversion and storage applications. It addresses thermal management, electrochemistry, dynamics modeling, and semiconductor switching in lithium-ion battery packs and power conversion circuits used in electric vehicles and microgrid systems.

- **Polysulfide management** in lithium-sulfur batteries is critical for mechanistic understanding and performance optimization of next-generation high-energy-density cells
- **Thermal management** is a primary safety and longevity concern in lithium-ion battery packs; phase change materials (PCM), micro heat pipes, and fin-enhanced systems provide active cooling/heating during charge-discharge cycles
- **Battery dynamics modeling** requires accurate parameter estimation from datasheets and optimization algorithms to predict state-of-charge, temperature distribution, and cycle life
- **Gate driver circuits** for SiC MOSFETs and IGBTs must handle high switching frequencies and voltage slew rates in power conversion applications
- **Electromagnetic interference (EMI)** and conducted/radiated emissions are critical design constraints in high-frequency switching converters feeding battery systems

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 電源・電池(内部構造の CT): [`fbp_volume`](../ops/tomography/volume/fbp_volume.md)(電池 CT の再構成、sinostack → voxel)、[`vol_wall_thickness`](../ops/3d/probe/vol_wall_thickness.md)(電極・セパレータの厚み、voxel → signal)、[`vol_label`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_label.md)(層のラベル、voxel → labels)、[`vol_region_props`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_region_props.md)(層の性質、labels → table)、[`metal_trace_interpolate`](../ops/tomography/artifact/metal_trace_interpolate.md)(金属アーチファクト、sinogram → sinogram)、[`beam_hardening_correct`](../ops/tomography/artifact/beam_hardening_correct.md)(カッピング、sinogram → sinogram)

## piezoelectric / control / actuators

**216 本**

This cluster covers piezoelectric and shape memory alloy (SMA) actuator technologies, including their control strategies, design methodologies, and real-world applications in robotics, surgical devices, and precision systems. The research spans actuator modeling, hysteresis compensation, adaptive control approaches, and performance optimization across mechanical and biomedical domains.

- **Actuator Types & Materials**: Shape memory alloys and piezoelectric materials are complementary smart materials with distinct actuation mechanisms—SMAs offer high energy density and compliance; piezoelectric actuators enable precision control and rapid response.
- **Hysteresis Compensation**: Both SMA and piezoelectric actuators exhibit nonlinear hysteresis behavior that degrades tracking accuracy; fuzzy approximation, inverse modeling, and observer-based techniques are used to mitigate these effects.
- **Adaptive & Intelligent Control**: Fuzzy systems, particle swarm optimization (PSO), sliding mode control, and disturbance observers provide robust performance across uncertain, time-varying operating conditions without requiring precise system models.
- **Design & Scaling Considerations**: SMA actuator performance depends critically on material properties, geometric form factors, thermal dynamics, and scaling effects; thermal response time is a primary bandwidth limitation.
- **Applications in Constrained Domains**: Surgical instruments, soft robots, MEMS switches, and biomedical devices leverage these actuators for compactness, biocompatibility, and compliance where traditional motors are impractical.

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- アクチュエータ(制御は外、動きを画像で測る側): [`displacement_series`](../ops/motionmag/measure/displacement_series.md)(変位の時系列、video → pairs)、[`phase_displacement`](../ops/motionmag/measure/phase_displacement.md)(位相ベースの微小変位、video → table)、[`riesz_displacement_series`](../ops/quat/motion/riesz_displacement_series.md)(Riesz 変換の変位、video → pairs)、[`temporal_band_power`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_band_power.md)(帯域ごとの動きの量、video → image2d)、[`band_snr`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/band_snr.md)(動きの SN、video → table)、[`order_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/order/order_spectrum.md)(回転次数、signal → table)、[`angular_resample`](../ops/acoustics/order/angular_resample.md)(回転同期、signal → table)、[`piv_multipass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_multipass.md)(流体(油空圧)の流れ場、image2d × image2d → flow2d)
- メッシュ・形状の計測と変換: [`mesh_area`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/mesh_area.md)(表面積、mesh → measurement)、[`mesh_volume`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/mesh_volume.md)(体積、mesh → measurement)、[`vertex_curvature`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/vertex_curvature.md)(曲率(角・フィレット)、mesh → curvature)、[`decimate_qem`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/decimate_qem.md)(間引き、mesh → mesh)、[`mesh_isotropic_remesh`](../ops/3d/resolution/mesh_isotropic_remesh.md)(等方リメッシュ、mesh → mesh)、[`mesh_to_voxel`](../ops/3d/transform/mesh_to_voxel.md)(メッシュ → 体積、mesh → voxel)、[`mesh_sample_points`](../ops/3d/resolution/mesh_sample_points.md)(メッシュ → 点群、mesh → points)、[`shape_index`](../ops/3d/curvature/shape_index.md)(局所形状の型、points → descriptor)

### servo / control / adaptive

## analysis / abstract / review

**630 本**

This cluster synthesizes systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and comprehensive analyses across medical, materials, and sensing technologies. It covers evidence-based evaluation methodologies, clinical guideline development, and broad-spectrum technology assessments that inform security and reliability considerations in healthcare devices, biosensors, and advanced materials.

- **Evidence synthesis frameworks**: Cochrane methodology, systematic reviews, and meta-analytic approaches for evaluating intervention efficacy and safety
- **Clinical guideline development**: Structured processes for translating research evidence into actionable clinical management strategies (e.g., heart failure diagnosis and treatment protocols)
- **Technology assessment patterns**: Multi-dimensional evaluation of emerging technologies (flexible sensors, bioelectronics, disposable diagnostics) across diagnostic accuracy, usability, and integration readiness
- **Cross-domain applicability**: Common review structures applicable to cardiovascular management, sensor deployment, materials science, and reliability engineering
- **Risk characterization**: Systematic identification of failure modes, adverse outcomes, and safety thresholds in both clinical and device contexts

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 文献のメタ議論(教育・レビュー) —— op なし(Fullseye の外)
- in-situ 監視(メルトプール・高速動画): [`temporal_bandpass`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_bandpass.md)(動画の時間帯域(揺らぎ)、video → video)、[`motion_magnify`](../ops/motionmag/magnify/motion_magnify.md)(微小な動きの拡大、video → table)、[`video_spacetime_cube`](../ops/videocube/cube/video_spacetime_cube.md)(時空間の立方体、video → voxel)、[`video_summary_keyframes`](../ops/videocube/summary/video_summary_keyframes.md)(要約コマ、video → indices)、[`blob_count`](../ops/2d/features/blob_count.md)(スパッタ・粒の数、region → feature)、[`area_center`](../ops/2d/features/area_center.md)(溶融池の面積と重心、region → match)、[`volseq_magnify_motion`](../ops/live4d/time/volseq_magnify_motion.md)(3D+t の拍動の拡大、volseq → volseq)、[`focus_sweep_height_video`](../ops/live4d/render/focus_sweep_height_video.md)(焦点掃引 → 高さの時系列、volseq → video)
- 寸法・幾何公差の計測 —— 入口: 検査ワークフロー層(計測 → 仕様 → 根拠つき Verdict)
- 寸法・幾何公差の計測: [`m1_measure_pos`](../ops/2d/measure1d/m1_measure_pos.md)(エッジ位置(1-D 計測)、image → contour)、[`m1_measure_pairs`](../ops/2d/measure1d/m1_measure_pairs.md)(対のエッジ = 幅、image → feature)、[`edges_sub_pix`](../ops/2d/contour/edges_sub_pix.md)(サブピクセル輪郭、image → contour)、[`fit_poly_surface`](../ops/3d/surface_fit/fit_poly_surface.md)(面の当てはめ、image2d × image2d × image2d → poly_surface)、[`surface_form_error`](../ops/3d/surface_fit/surface_form_error.md)(平面度・形状誤差、image2d → measurement)、[`ransac_plane`](../ops/3d/robust_fit/ransac_plane.md)(基準面、points → primitive)、[`distance_point_plane`](../ops/3d/geometry/distance_point_plane.md)(点と面の距離(高さ)、points × primitive → measurement)、[`angle_between_planes`](../ops/3d/geometry/angle_between_planes.md)(面の角度、primitive → measurement)
- 予知保全(振動・軸受): [`bearing_defect_frequencies`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/bearing_defect_frequencies.md)(軸受の欠陥周波数、 → table)、[`envelope_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/envelope_spectrum.md)(包絡スペクトル、signal → table)、[`spectral_kurtosis`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/spectral_kurtosis.md)(衝撃の帯域、signal → table)、[`cepstrum`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/cepstrum.md)(ケプストラム、signal → table)、[`order_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/order/order_spectrum.md)(次数スペクトル、signal → table)、[`stft`](../ops/acoustics/transform/stft.md)(時間周波数、signal → table)、[`spc_ewma`](../ops/spc/change/spc_ewma.md)(劣化の監視、signal → table)、[`phase_displacement`](../ops/motionmag/measure/phase_displacement.md)(位相ベースの変位、video → table)
- センサ(校正・深度・融合) —— 入口: `docs/SENSOR_PLAYBOOK.md`

## inertial / navigation / calibration

**158 本**

This cluster covers the systematic calibration, integration, and optimization of inertial navigation systems (INS) with complementary sensors like GNSS and visual systems. It addresses the fundamental challenge of achieving accurate position and orientation estimates through multi-sensor fusion, thermal compensation, and advanced filtering techniques suitable for marine, aerial, agricultural, and GPS-denied environments.

- **IMU Calibration Fundamentals**: Systematic calibration methods for gyro drift (≤0.01°/hr) and accelerometer bias stability (≤0.1mg/year) are essential; thermal effects significantly impact MEMS sensor accuracy and require dedicated characterization procedures.
- **Sensor Fusion Architectures**: Both loosely and tightly coupled GNSS/INS integration strategies exist, with factor graph optimization (FGO) emerging as a competitive alternative to extended Kalman filter (EKF) approaches for real-time positioning.
- **Multi-Modal Integration**: Visual-inertial fusion, stereo-GNSS-inertial SLAM, and odometer-aided positioning extend navigation capabilities beyond traditional INS/GNSS in constrained or denied-signal environments.
- **Error Propagation & Drift**: INS systems accumulate unbounded drift over exploratory trajectories; loop closure, place revisiting, and learned error models (RNNs, neural networks) are critical for maintaining bounded localization error.
- **Calibration Automation**: External multi-modal sensor calibration lacks standardized automation; accuracy, robustness, and computational efficiency remain open challenges in field deployment.

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- センサ(校正・深度・融合) —— 入口: `docs/SENSOR_PLAYBOOK.md`
- センサ(校正・深度・融合): [`calibration_views`](../ops/optics/imaging_sim/calibration_views.md)(校正板の合成ビュー、table → table)、[`distortion_map`](../ops/optics/imaging_sim/distortion_map.md)(歪みの地図、table → table)、[`pnp_ransac`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/pnp_ransac.md)(外部パラメータ、points × keypoints → pose)、[`bundle_adjust`](../ops/3d/bundle_adjust/bundle_adjust.md)(多視点の同時最適化、pose × points → table)、[`project_spherical`](../ops/3d/lidar_projection/project_spherical.md)(LiDAR の球面投影、points → image2d)、[`depth_to_points`](../ops/3d/transform/depth_to_points.md)(深度 → 点群、depth → points)、[`normals_from_depth`](../ops/3d/range_image/normals_from_depth.md)(深度 → 法線、depth → normalmap)、[`dtof_depth`](../ops/photon/dtof/dtof_depth.md)(dToF の距離、counts → measurement)
- 寸法・幾何公差の計測 —— 入口: 検査ワークフロー層(計測 → 仕様 → 根拠つき Verdict)

## event / time / network

**247 本**

This cluster covers temporal and event-driven security analysis across networked systems, from real-time anomaly detection in streaming data to timing-sensitive vulnerabilities in automotive and embedded networks. It bridges neuromorphic event-based sensing, network communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet), and time-critical intrusion detection systems.

- **Event-based processing** enables low-latency detection compared to frame-based approaches, critical for real-time security monitoring
- **CAN bus vulnerabilities** stem from legacy design lacking authentication; intrusion detection requires understanding frame timing, message patterns, and network topology
- **Temporal anomalies** in network traffic (unusual timing, message sequences, event rates) reveal attacks that static content analysis misses
- **Gateway timing analysis** in heterogeneous networks (CAN-to-Ethernet) introduces synchronization challenges that attackers can exploit
- **Real-time constraints** in embedded systems demand lightweight detection models; CNN-based approaches must balance accuracy against computational overhead

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 時間・イベント(高速・非同期): [`video_spacetime_cube`](../ops/videocube/cube/video_spacetime_cube.md)(時空間の立方体、video → voxel)、[`photon_sample`](../ops/photon/counting/photon_sample.md)(光子到達の標本化、image2d → image2d)、[`tcspc_stats`](../ops/photon/tcspc/tcspc_stats.md)(時間相関の統計、counts → table)、[`temporal_bandpass`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_bandpass.md)(時間帯域、video → video)
- 外観欠陥の検出(成形・表面): [`dc_local_contrast_norm`](../ops/2d/decomposition/dc_local_contrast_norm.md)(照明むらを除いた局所コントラスト、image → image)、[`dc_rpca_sparse`](../ops/2d/decomposition/dc_rpca_sparse.md)(背景から外れる疎な欠陥、image → image)、[`defect_contrast`](../ops/optics/illumination/defect_contrast.md)(照明条件での欠陥コントラスト、table → table)、[`illumination_design`](../ops/optics/illumination/illumination_design.md)(欠陥が出る照明の設計、 → table)、[`lighting_sweep`](../ops/optics/illumination/lighting_sweep.md)(照明を振って最良を探す、 → pairs)、[`auto_threshold`](../ops/2d/segmentation/auto_threshold.md)(二値化、image → region)、[`blob_count`](../ops/2d/features/blob_count.md)(欠陥の数、region → feature)、[`circularity`](../ops/2d/features/circularity.md)(形の記述、region → feature)
- センサ(校正・深度・融合) —— 入口: `docs/SENSOR_PLAYBOOK.md`
- センサ(校正・深度・融合): [`calibration_views`](../ops/optics/imaging_sim/calibration_views.md)(校正板の合成ビュー、table → table)、[`distortion_map`](../ops/optics/imaging_sim/distortion_map.md)(歪みの地図、table → table)、[`pnp_ransac`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/pnp_ransac.md)(外部パラメータ、points × keypoints → pose)、[`bundle_adjust`](../ops/3d/bundle_adjust/bundle_adjust.md)(多視点の同時最適化、pose × points → table)、[`project_spherical`](../ops/3d/lidar_projection/project_spherical.md)(LiDAR の球面投影、points → image2d)、[`depth_to_points`](../ops/3d/transform/depth_to_points.md)(深度 → 点群、depth → points)、[`normals_from_depth`](../ops/3d/range_image/normals_from_depth.md)(深度 → 法線、depth → normalmap)、[`dtof_depth`](../ops/photon/dtof/dtof_depth.md)(dToF の距離、counts → measurement)
- 通信・組込み(Fullseye の外) —— 入口: `docs/CONNECTIVITY.md`(産業プロトコルの対応表)
- 光学・照明・撮像系: [`lens_system`](../ops/optics/design/lens_system.md)(レンズ系の定義、 → table)、[`paraxial_trace`](../ops/optics/design/paraxial_trace.md)(近軸追跡、table → table)、[`mtf_diffraction`](../ops/optics/imaging/mtf_diffraction.md)(MTF、 → pairs)、[`depth_of_field`](../ops/optics/geometric/depth_of_field.md)(焦点深度、 → table)、[`illumination_uniformity`](../ops/optics/illumination/illumination_uniformity.md)(照明の均一性、image2d → table)、[`render_through_lens`](../ops/optics/imaging_sim/render_through_lens.md)(設計レンズ越しの像、image2d × table → image2d)、[`spectrum_to_srgb`](../ops/optics/appearance/spectrum_to_srgb.md)(分光 → 色、signal → vector)

## rehabilitation / robot / control

**276 本**

This cluster covers the design, control, and safety aspects of robotic systems used in rehabilitation and assistive applications, including exoskeletons, prosthetics, and humanoid robots. It addresses advanced actuator control techniques—particularly series elastic actuators (SEAs), hydraulic systems, and adaptive neural controllers—that enable safe physical human-robot interaction and precise force/torque management.

- **Series Elastic Actuator (SEA) Control**: Force and position control strategies that maintain low bandwidth while achieving high performance through active disturbance rejection and extended state observers
- **Disturbance Observer-Based Adaptive Control**: Integration of neural backstepping, integral sliding mode control, and adaptive techniques to handle unknown system dynamics in flexible-joint and hydraulic robots
- **Physical Human-Robot Interaction (pHRI) Safety**: Modeling and parameter identification methods (including Physics-Informed Neural Networks) to ensure safe collaborative operation and force limiting
- **Actuator Dynamics and Transmission Design**: Scaling laws and decoupled control approaches for electric motors, gear systems, and hydraulic actuators to meet low-speed, high-torque requirements
- **Energy-Efficient Closed-Loop Control**: Techniques for precision control in resource-constrained robotic systems, particularly relevant to wearable rehabilitation devices

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- アクチュエータ(制御は外、動きを画像で測る側): [`displacement_series`](../ops/motionmag/measure/displacement_series.md)(変位の時系列、video → pairs)、[`phase_displacement`](../ops/motionmag/measure/phase_displacement.md)(位相ベースの微小変位、video → table)、[`riesz_displacement_series`](../ops/quat/motion/riesz_displacement_series.md)(Riesz 変換の変位、video → pairs)、[`temporal_band_power`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_band_power.md)(帯域ごとの動きの量、video → image2d)、[`band_snr`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/band_snr.md)(動きの SN、video → table)、[`order_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/order/order_spectrum.md)(回転次数、signal → table)、[`angular_resample`](../ops/acoustics/order/angular_resample.md)(回転同期、signal → table)、[`piv_multipass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_multipass.md)(流体(油空圧)の流れ場、image2d × image2d → flow2d)

- ロボット(姿勢・位置合わせ・動き): [`pnp_ransac`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/pnp_ransac.md)(カメラから物体の姿勢、points × keypoints → pose)、[`dlt_pose`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/dlt_pose.md)(姿勢の直接解、points × keypoints → pose)、[`reprojection_error`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/reprojection_error.md)(姿勢の検証、points × keypoints → measurement)、[`optimize_pose_graph`](../ops/3d/pose_graph/optimize_pose_graph.md)(軌跡の整合、pose → table)、[`relative_pose`](../ops/3d/pose_graph/relative_pose.md)(相対姿勢、pose × pose → pose)、[`register_cpd_rigid`](../ops/3d/deform/register_cpd_rigid.md)(剛体の位置合わせ、points × points → pose)、[`icp_point2plane`](../ops/3d/refine/icp_point2plane.md)(ICP、points × points × normals → pose)、[`estimate_flow`](../ops/3d/motion_segment/estimate_flow.md)(3D の流れ、points × points → flow_scattered)

## soft / materials / tactile

**350 本**

This cluster covers the convergence of soft materials, tactile sensing, and interactive technologies for creating responsive electronic systems. It encompasses flexible pressure sensors, electronic skin (e-skin), haptic interfaces, and soft robotic actuators that enable touch-based perception and feedback in wearables, robotics, and human-machine interfaces.

- **Electronic Skin (E-skin) Architecture**: Flexible, pressure-sensitive substrates that mimic biological skin for haptic perception in robots and wearables; integration of sensing and energy harvesting.
- **Tactile Sensor Design**: Pressure and force sensors built from conducting polymers, elastomers, and composite materials; sensitivity, response time, and durability trade-offs.
- **Soft Actuation Methods**: Pneumatic networks (pneu-nets), electromagnetic actuators, and magnetic actuation for controlled motion in flexible systems; stiffness-tuning and fast-response mechanisms.
- **Energy Autonomy in Tactile Systems**: Self-powered e-skin using triboelectric nanogenerators and energy harvesting to enable longer operational lifespans without external power.
- **Material Properties**: Elastomeric substrates, hydrogel composites, and multimaterial 3D printing for achieving flexibility, stretchability, and mechanical tunability.

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- センサ(校正・深度・融合): [`calibration_views`](../ops/optics/imaging_sim/calibration_views.md)(校正板の合成ビュー、table → table)、[`distortion_map`](../ops/optics/imaging_sim/distortion_map.md)(歪みの地図、table → table)、[`pnp_ransac`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/pnp_ransac.md)(外部パラメータ、points × keypoints → pose)、[`bundle_adjust`](../ops/3d/bundle_adjust/bundle_adjust.md)(多視点の同時最適化、pose × points → table)、[`project_spherical`](../ops/3d/lidar_projection/project_spherical.md)(LiDAR の球面投影、points → image2d)、[`depth_to_points`](../ops/3d/transform/depth_to_points.md)(深度 → 点群、depth → points)、[`normals_from_depth`](../ops/3d/range_image/normals_from_depth.md)(深度 → 法線、depth → normalmap)、[`dtof_depth`](../ops/photon/dtof/dtof_depth.md)(dToF の距離、counts → measurement)
